name: BecomeAroused
description: The talk turns flirtatious, romantic or erotic and it really excites the speaking NPC: their arousal rises a little. Not for friendly talk. Silent: never say or narrate this action or any level; just speak as you would.
note: Needs OSL Aroused and Mantella Living World - Arousal. Each use adds 10 arousal (0-100) to the NPC who speaks. Only offered to the player's lovers, an open group off duty, or NPCs the player allowed intimacy with (the Hub's hotkey); a friend alone is not enough.
prompt: If the conversation turns flirtatious, romantic or erotic and it genuinely excites you, begin your response with '{key}:'
